title: Final source-proof replay can outlive the last live publisher HEAD check
locators: campaign_publication.py:1247-1273 (recheck checks capture then source proof and remaining state)
campaign_publication.py:1305-1307 (finish receipt then final recheck and complete return)
reproduction: Run the retained probe with the frozen21061 source and actual pinned Claw76c. The independent negative wrapper calls the real _owner_proof and returns its unchanged result. During the second such call after the publication log has been flushed as complete, make a real private Git commit. This happens in the final live recheck after its capture.verify HEAD check. publish returns complete and both publication/native receipts remain nonempty although actual HEAD differs from accepted source baseline.
cause: The registered HEAD check runs at the beginning of capture.verify. Live recheck subsequently performs the substantial source-proof replay and other checks without checking HEAD again at its completion. The added preflight/final-callback coverage therefore does not retain freshness through the entire final recheck.
bounded_fix: Retain the live transaction HEAD check through the end of the live recheck after actual source-proof replay and remaining validation, before final success return. Keep the historical completed validator exempt and do not restrict ordinary uncommitted derived synchronization or weaken existing content/proof checks.
acceptance_tests: Actual source and pinned generation positive with tracked uncommitted derived sync remains complete.
Inject a real HEAD-changing commit after real source-proof replay during the final live publication recheck; publication must fail and clear success-shaped receipts, retaining recovery evidence.
Historical validate after a legitimate later commit still verifies exact required bytes; modified current owner/receipt/native proof still refuses.
fault_injection_disclosure: Negative wrapper only schedules the private commit after the real proof; no fabricated source proof, native generation, receipt maker, or positive-path gate is substituted. This is a tiny private mechanical fixture, not actual campaign application or scientific admission.
prior_finding_relationship: Residual implementation gap in #1256 publisher correction, not a renewed blanket current-HEAD requirement on historical verification.

supersedes_metadata.change: Precise final-recheck source locator only; finding and evidence unchanged.
